param: δt Discrete time step length
N Population size for the season (use N2012/13, N2013/14, or N2014/15)
N2012/13 Population size, season 2012/13
N2013/14 Population size, season 2013/14
N2014/15 Population size, season 2014/15
β Transmission rate (rate at which new infections take place given a contact); used in λ(t)=β*I/N
λ(t) Force of infection at time t
σ Daily rate of progression through latent stages (E1→E2 and E2→I1); mean latent/incubation period dL=2/σ
γ Daily rate of progression through infectious stages (I1→I2 and I2→R); mean infectious period dI=2/γ
π Initial susceptibility (proportion susceptible at start of season)
λ0 Initial infection rate parameter used in early growth re-parameterisation (EGR)
ψ Exponential growth rate parameter used in early growth re-parameterisation (EGR)
η Negative binomial over-dispersion parameter for weekly ICU counts
pICU Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection
π_prior_low Lower bound of prior for π ~ Unif(0,1)
π_prior_high Upper bound of prior for π ~ Unif(0,1)
λ0_prior_low Lower bound of prior for λ0 ~ Unif(0,0.000241)
λ0_prior_high Upper bound of prior for λ0 ~ Unif(0,0.000241)
ψ_prior_low Lower bound of prior for ψ ~ Unif(0,0.39)
ψ_prior_high Upper bound of prior for ψ ~ Unif(0,0.39)
η_prior_low Lower bound of prior for η ~ Unif(1,100)
η_prior_high Upper bound of prior for η ~ Unif(1,100)
pICU_prior_low Lower bound of prior for pICU ~ Unif(0,1)
pICU_prior_high Upper bound of prior for pICU ~ Unif(0,1)
μICU|E Mean time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (delay distribution mean)
σ2ICU|E Variance of time from infection to ICU/HDU admission (delay distribution variance)
R0 Basic reproduction number (derived from β, σ, γ and initial conditions; reported in results)
Rn Effective reproduction number in partially immune population (function of π and ψ; reported in results)
I0 Initial total infectious individuals (derived; reported in results)
TAR Total attack rate over the season (probability of infection for a susceptible individual; reported in results)
